context: A boss reviews a service rollout schedule with his manager
purpose: Teach: 除き/主宰/遵守/合致/猶予/なおし/パーソナル/シニア

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新サービスのロールアウト計画だが、シニア向けプランの開始日を確認したい。
lines.en: About the new service rollout plan, I want to confirm the start date for the senior-oriented plan.
lines.style: Calm authoritative tone, measured pace, slight downward inflection at end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、シニアプランとパーソナル診断サービスは予定通り来月一日に開始いたします。
lines.en: Yes, the senior plan and personal diagnostic service will launch as scheduled on the first of next month.
lines.style: Respectful business register, crisp delivery, steady professional pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 法務から関連規則の遵守について最終確認は取れているのか?
lines.en: Have you obtained final confirmation from legal regarding compliance with the relevant regulations?
lines.style: Slightly probing intonation, firm question, brief pause before key noun.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 一部の地方拠点を除き、全社で体制が整いました。北海道支社のみ猶予を申請しています。
lines.en: Compliance is in place company-wide except for a few regional bases. Only the Hokkaido branch has requested a grace period.
lines.style: Slightly apologetic tone on the exception, then recovers to factual reporting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 猶予は何日までだ?その間に資料のなおしも入るだろう。
lines.en: Until when is the grace period? Revisions to the materials will likely come up during that time.
lines.style: Direct managerial concern, clipped delivery, mild frown audible in voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 今月末までです。社長が主宰される運営委員会で再提出する予定です。
lines.en: Until the end of this month. We plan to resubmit it at the steering committee chaired by the president.
lines.style: Polite deferential phrasing, careful enunciation of formal business terms.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: わかった。資料は本部の戦略方針に合致するよう仕上げてくれ。
lines.en: Understood. Make sure the materials are finalized so they align with headquarters' strategic policy.
lines.style: Decisive closing tone, slight warmth, instructional but not harsh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。週末までに修正版をお持ちします。
lines.en: Understood. I will bring the revised version by the weekend.
lines.style: Crisp affirmative response, slight bow implied in voice, confident delivery.
